about: NATIVE_MODEL_REGISTRY descriptors for the stage-1 animals from the PS2 meshes (lane ps2cast-4, PS2_ANIMALS; tools/ps2_cast.py regcast). Replaces the external cast's v8-tiles descriptors (stage1-animals-rooms.json) with the same names, BIN / TPL rows and room lists; the crow joins its rooms. Render only: the GC skeleton, motions, collision and AI are unchanged. Textures: the PS2 TPLs (same size as the GC's; the GC bake was not better, see the lane doc). Normals flattened (PS2CAST_FLAT_NORMALS=1): the animals draw with the constant actor light, normals are never read.
lighting: dog, cow, chicken: flat (as today's registry animals); crow: the source GX lighting record (as today's source-path crow; NATIVE_MODEL_REGISTRY_SOURCE_LIGHT bit 3)
